card.name: Generic noun after a proper name
card.fires_on: The word right after a proper name that names an organization, place or thing, such as Family, Hospital, Forest, Palace, School or Medical. It also fires on the start of such words, like Minist or Vol.

modes.label: Institution type after a name
modes.description: A word like Hospital, School, Medical or Minist follows a proper name to form an organization name.
modes.example: Southboro<< Medical>> Group in Southboro, MA

modes.label: Place or landmark type after a name
modes.description: A word like Forest, Palace, Vol or arch follows a place name.

modes.label: Other noun after a name
modes.description: A noun such as Family or trial follows a surname or study name.
modes.example: Seiwert<< Family>> History Seiwert Surname History

card.writes: It pushes toward company-type endings such as Studios, Ltd, Pty and Holdings after a name.
card.plain: It fires on the word that follows a proper name and completes the name of a group, place or institution.
